# 7. GIST

## A. University snapshot

| Field | Verified answer |
|---|---|
| University | Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology (GIST) |
| Country / city / campus | Republic of Korea · Gwangju · GIST campus |
| Type | Public STEM/research institute |
| Fall 2027 status | **CONFIRMED FOR FALL 2027** |
| Platform | GIST International Undergraduate Admission System |
| Application URL | [Official GIST portal](https://service.gist.ac.kr/admission/uniforeigner) |
| Best programmes | Undeclared freshman → **Artificial Intelligence** or **Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (EECS)** |
| Degree / language | Bachelor’s; English-medium science/engineering curriculum under international route |
| Major structure | First year undeclared; choose major at end of freshman year |
| Approximate intake | Approximately **15** international undergraduates in the 2027 guide |

## Changes since 13 Sep 2026

- The current Fall 2027 guide is verified and explicitly requires one standardized academic test, one English test and one recommendation.
- **Correction:** the old audit’s “free application” cannot be treated as confirmed for Fall 2027 because the current guide does not state a fee and the live cycle form is not open. Fee is now marked **TBA**.
- Current official scholarship page provides undergraduate allowance amounts; housing notice provides 2026 rates.
- A serious NIS timing ambiguity remains: eligibility permits graduation by 31 July 2027, but the guide also says successful applicants submit the authenticated diploma by registration and that applicants graduating after early July cannot apply. Registration ends 25 June. Written clarification is required.

## B. Programmes

| Official programme | Degree / unit | Entry / prerequisites | Restrictions |
|---|---|---|---|
| Artificial Intelligence | Bachelor’s; College of AI | Select after undeclared first year. No programme-specific applicant calculus/programming/physics minimum published. | Available to international students under guide list |
| Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (EECS) | Bachelor’s; College of AI | Broad hardware/software/computing route | Available to international students |
| AI Convergence (AX) | Bachelor’s; College of AI | Interdisciplinary AI application route | Available, but AI/EECS are closer to core CS profile |
| Semiconductor Engineering | Bachelor’s | — | **Korean-only** under current guide; not an option for this applicant |

**Best programme for me:** Artificial Intelligence for a focused AI profile, or EECS for the stronger general computing/software foundation and flexibility. If the applicant is undecided between research AI and broad CS, EECS is the safer base.

## C. Application rounds and deadlines

Source: [official Fall 2027 guide](https://www.gist.ac.kr/iuadm/img/sub02/2027_Fall_Undergraduate_Admission_Guideline.pdf).

| Event | Date | Time / zone | Confirmed? | What must be ready |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Application opens | 1 Dec 2026 | Not stated | Yes | GIST portal account |
| Application + documents | **29 Jan 2027** | Not stated | Yes | Form, required tests, recommendation, uploads |
| Document evaluation | 1 Feb–31 Mar 2027 | — | Yes | Monitor email |
| Interview, selected applicants | Within evaluation period | TBA | Partial | Required if invited |
| Decision expected | **30 Apr 2027** | — | Yes | Email/portal |
| Registration | **4 May–25 Jun 2027** | — | Yes | Accept and final-document process |
| Final authenticated diploma | Guide links it to registration; exact workable date unclear | — | Ambiguous | Written confirmation for NIS |
| Semester start | Fall 2027 | TBA | Partial | Visa/housing/orientation |

One non-binding round is published. Do not invent a KST closing time; the guide gives only the date.

### My recommended timeline

- Email the diploma/apostille question **now (4–6 October)**.
- Choose Math/CS/Physics recommender by **1 November**; ask by **10 November**.
- Request NIS transcript, profile, grading scale and expected-graduation evidence by **20 November**.
- Open the portal on **1 December** and capture any newly exposed essays/recommendation questions.
- Order standardized and English official reports by **15 December** if the portal requires agency delivery.
- Finalize uploads by **12 January**; submit **18–20 January**; recommender target **15 January**.

## D. Platform and fee

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Platform | GIST own international undergraduate system |
| Programme choices | Admission undeclared; no final major choice at application |
| Editing / updates | Exact Fall 2027 portal behavior TBA until 1 Dec |
| Application fee | **TBA / not stated in the 2027 guide** |
| Refund / waiver | TBA |
| Separate scholarship fee | None published |
| Initial paper mail | Upload first; successful applicants later send originals/authenticated documents by post |

## E. Document checklist

| Document | Required? | Who submits | When / format | Notes |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| GIST application | R | Applicant | By 29 Jan | Live fields open 1 Dec |
| Applicant passport/national ID | R | Applicant | Upload scan | Identity/nationality |
| Both parents’ passports/nationality IDs | R | Applicant | Upload | Citizenship route |
| Family relationship/birth certificate | Not listed for ordinary applicants in 2027 guide | — | — | Do not import older-guide requirement; portal should be checked |
| All-year high-school transcript | R | Applicant uploads school-issued record | By deadline | If final semester unavailable, through first semester Grade 12 plus current coursework |
| Diploma/expected graduation | R | Applicant uploads school official evidence | By deadline | School letter may show date if certificate unavailable |
| Final NIS certificate/transcript | POST | Applicant/courier | Authenticated after admission | Timing conflict; confirm in writing |
| Standardized academic test | **R** | Applicant uploads official evidence; verification may follow | By deadline | At least one recognized category |
| English test | **R** | Applicant / testing agency as instructed | By deadline | Official score; no minimum published |
| Recommendation | **R, one** | Recommender | Direct online procedure | Printed/signed/scanned PDF after online entry |
| Awards/honors | O | Applicant | Up to 5 | National olympiad alone is not accepted as the standardized-test category |
| School profile | O / highly recommended | Applicant | Upload | Explain NIS curriculum/grading |
| TOPIK | O | Applicant | Upload | Not an English substitute |
| CV / activities / GitHub / portfolio | No separate required item published | Applicant only if live form allows | — | Do not substitute for formal evidence |
| Essays | Not published in guide | Applicant if portal asks | TBA | Inspect 1 Dec |
| Original/apostilled diploma and records | POST | Applicant/courier | By registration/offer deadline | Apostille or consular verification |

## F. NIS route and eligibility conflict

- The guide does not publish NIS-specific grades, HL-subject rules or a Kazakhstan Attestat equivalency route.
- It accepts expected-graduation evidence at application and permits general eligibility for applicants graduating by **31 July 2027**.
- It separately says applicants whose graduation date is **after early July cannot apply**, and successful applicants must submit the apostilled/consular-verified diploma in connection with registration, which ends **25 June**.
- A June NIS certificate may satisfy the “before early July” statement, but apostille processing could extend past registration. This is an official-source ambiguity, not something to guess.
- Predicted results are expressly accepted for IB/A-level, not specifically for NIS. Use the current transcript and expected-graduation letter and ask whether NIS predicted results can supplement them.
- No NIS English-medium waiver is published; an accepted English test is required unless the applicant meets the guide’s native-country exemption.

## G. Academic and testing requirements

### Official minimum

Meet citizenship and graduation timing; submit complete school records, at least one recognized standardized academic test and one accepted English score. No GPA, NIS grade, SAT, Math or English-score minimum is published.

### Competitive target — analysis

Strong Math/science grades, externally comparable testing and a coherent technical profile are useful for a ~15-place international intake. SAT 1300–1350 and IELTS 7.0–7.5 meet no published threshold because none exists; GIST remains a reach.

| Test | Rule |
|---|---|
| SAT / ACT | Accepted as the required academic-test category; no minimum/superscore rule published |
| AP / IB / A-level | Accepted; IB/A-level predicted scores accepted |
| International olympiad | Accepted category under guide rules |
| Relevant national leaving/entrance exam | Accepted with explanation of process/competitiveness/result |
| National olympiad | Not accepted as the required standardized-test category |
| IELTS / TOEFL | Accepted; no minimum; TOEFL institution code **0144** |
| TEPS / TOEIC | Accepted |
| Cambridge CAE/CPE, PTE Academic, Duolingo | Accepted |
| Validity | English score within two years |
| Reporting | Guide calls for official test evidence. Confirm live-portal agency delivery for IELTS/SAT; provider fees are separate. |

## H. Interview / internal exams

No universal internal exam is published. Selected applicants may be interviewed and must participate. The 2027 guide does not publish Math/science subjects, length or weighting; older FAQ descriptions must not be treated as current-cycle facts.

## I. Recommendation

| Item | Fall 2027 rule |
|---|---|
| Number | **One required** |
| Preferred recommender | Academic adviser, homeroom, Math or Science teacher |
| Submission | Recommender enters content online, prints the form, signs by hand, scans and uploads PDF; applicant cannot complete submission until it is received |
| Exact questions/ratings/limits | Not public before portal opening |

**My strategy:** use a Math or CS teacher with concrete evidence of technical reasoning and independent work. Confirm the teacher can complete the print-sign-scan step. Inspect the live form on 1 December for exact questions before the teacher drafts the final text.

## J. Essays

| Essay | Prompt | Limit | Status |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Application written responses | Not stated in the public 2027 guide | TBA | Inspect portal 1 Dec |
| Scholarship essay | None published | — | Scholarship is tied to international-student status/admission |

No exact prompt can responsibly be supplied yet.

## K. Scholarships and aid

Source: [official international undergraduate scholarship page](https://www.gist.ac.kr/iuadm/html/sub03/0301.html).

| Category | Award | Separate application? | Rule |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Tuition | International undergraduate tuition waiver | No | Full tuition, maximum 8 semesters |
| Student allowance | Basic allowance | No separate form stated | KRW 130k/month; ≥11 credits and no academic probation/disciplinary suspension |
| Meal allowance | Meal support | No separate form stated | KRW 270k/month under same academic-status conditions |
| International allowance | Additional international support | No separate form stated | KRW 130k/month with prior GPA ≥3.0/4.5 |
| Settlement | New international student support | No | KRW 200k once |
| Flight | Arrival support | Claim after arrival | One-way flight reimbursement under current rules |
| Health | Insurance support | Reimbursement/document process | Current official international materials state 100% monthly contribution reimbursement; confirm 2027 procedure |
| Need-based | No separate international undergraduate need-based application found | — | Not published |

### Coverage, renewal and gap

| Cost | Covered? | Rule |
|---|---:|---|
| Tuition | Yes | Full, 8 semesters |
| Housing | No | Student pays |
| Meals | Allowance, not a guaranteed meal plan | KRW 270k/month under conditions |
| Monthly stipend | Yes | KRW 130k basic; potential additional KRW 130k international allowance with GPA condition |
| Insurance | Reimbursement stated | Exact 2027 premium/procedure TBA |
| Flight | Yes, one way | Reimbursement; exact eligible itinerary/claim evidence controls |
| Visa/books/laptop/local transport/summer housing | Not guaranteed | Personal cost |

Current 2026 dorm notice: double KRW 112,600/month, triple KRW 74,200/month, deposit KRW 140k and bedding KRW 20k/month; single rooms from second year KRW 132,600/month. Capacity restrictions apply and summer/seasonal housing requires a valid reason/approval, so housing is not documented as an unconditional four-year guarantee. [Official housing page](https://www.gist.ac.kr/en/html/sub05/05030403.html) and [current fee notice](https://ipa.gist.ac.kr/site/en/html/sub05/050207.html?GotoPage=1&mode=V&no=222513).

Because food, personal spending and exact insurance/2027 housing are variable, a guaranteed annual gap is not officially calculable. The current stipend can plausibly cover low dorm charges, but this is not equivalent to full cost of attendance.

## L. After admission

Accept/register 4 May–25 June; mail original authenticated/apostilled diploma and other requested records; obtain visa issuance documentation after records are accepted; arrange paid dormitory and insurance; submit flight reimbursement evidence; attend orientation. The final NIS/apostille sequence must be resolved with admissions before relying on the offer.

## M. Strategic assessment — analysis

- **Admission difficulty:** Reach, intensified by ~15 published places.
- **Full-funding difficulty:** Primarily admission; package is strong but leaves housing/food/personal gaps and GPA/credit conditions apply to allowances.
- **Fit:** Very strong because both AI and EECS are explicit undergraduate choices after first year.

## N. Still TBA / needs confirmation

Application fee/refund/waiver; live-form essays and limits; exact recommendation questions; official SAT/IELTS delivery mechanism and deadlines; interview format/weight; definitive NIS diploma/apostille deadline; 2027 dorm allocation/rates; insurance and flight-claim details; registration deposit, if any.

The 2027 guide permits graduation by 31 July but lists registration through 25 June and also refers to submission of an apostilled diploma. May I apply with an official expected-graduation letter and current transcript, then submit the final NIS Certificate and apostille after its June release? Please give the latest acceptable date for the final certificate and apostille and confirm whether this timing meets the “early July” rule.

A June NIS certificate may satisfy the “.ru: Июньский сертификат NIS может соответствовать условию «до начала июля», но апостиль может занять время после конца регистрации. Это неоднозначность официального источника, не вопрос для догадки.

Meet citizenship and graduation timing;.en: Meet citizenship and graduation timing; submit complete school records, at least one recognized standardized academic test and one accepted English score. No GPA, NIS grade, SAT, Math or English-score minimum is published.

**My strategy:** use a Math or CS teache.en: **My strategy:** use a Math or CS teacher with concrete evidence of technical reasoning and independent work. Confirm the teacher can complete the print-sign-scan step. Inspect the live form on 1 December for exact questions before the teacher drafts the final text.

Есть ограничения мест; летнее / сезонное проживание требует основания / разрешения. Безусловная гарантия всех четырёх лет не документирована. [Официальное проживание](https://www.gist.ac.kr/en/html/sub05/05030403.html) и [текущие тарифы](https://ipa.gist.ac.kr/site/en/html/sub05/050207.html?GotoPage=1&mode=V&no=222513).
Current 2026 dorm notice: double KRW 112.en: Current 2026 dorm notice: double KRW 112,600/month, triple KRW 74,200/month, deposit KRW 140k and bedding KRW 20k/month; single rooms from second year KRW 132,600/month. Capacity restrictions apply and summer/seasonal housing requires a valid reason/approval, so housing is not documented as an unconditional four-year guarantee. [Official housing page](https://www.gist.ac.kr/en/html/sub05/05030403.html) and [current fee notice](https://ipa.gist.ac.kr/site/en/html/sub05/050207.html?GotoPage=1&mode=V&no=222513).

Because food, personal spending and exac.en: Because food, personal spending and exact insurance/2027 housing are variable, a guaranteed annual gap is not officially calculable. The current stipend can plausibly cover low dorm charges, but this is not equivalent to full cost of attendance.

**Full-funding difficulty:** Primarily a.en: **Full-funding difficulty:** Primarily admission; package is strong but leaves housing/food/personal gaps and GPA/credit conditions apply to allowances.

I am an NIS Grade 12 applicant from Kaza.ru: Я кандидат NIS Grade 12 из Казахстана; итоговый сертификат получу в июне 2027 после дедлайна подачи. Руководство 2027 допускает выпуск до 31 июля, но регистрацию — до 25 июня, и требует диплом с апостилем. Можно ли подать официальное письмо об ожидаемом выпуске и текущий транскрипт, затем итоговый сертификат NIS и апостиль после июньской выдачи? Укажите крайнюю допустимую дату сертификата / апостиля и подтвердите соответствие правилу «начало июля».
I am an NIS Grade 12 applicant from Kaza.en: I am an NIS Grade 12 applicant from Kazakhstan. My final NIS Certificate is issued in June 2027, after the application deadline. The 2027 guide permits graduation by 31 July but lists registration through 25 June and also refers to submission of an apostilled diploma. May I apply with an official expected-graduation letter and current transcript, then submit the final NIS Certificate and apostille after its June release? Please give the latest acceptable date for the final certificate and apostille and confirm whether this timing meets the “early July” rule.
